sections.h2: Getting the most from a small budget
sections.html:
• Buy the accessory, not the device. A magnetic power bank or a selfie tripod upgrades a phone they already love.
  • Watch the hidden extras. Instant cameras need film, trackers need a phone of the right brand.
  • Cheap chargers and power banks need care: stick to known brands with safety marks; badly made batteries can overheat.
  • Sales help most here. Small gadgets often get the biggest percentage discounts around Black Friday.

faqs.q: What’s a good tech gift under $25 or £20?
faqs.a: Item trackers (bought singly), volume-limited kids’ headphones, LED strip lights and selfie stick tripods are often found around this price, depending on brand and sales. Check today’s price with the button on each card.

faqs.q: What are good stocking fillers for teenagers?
faqs.a: Keychain cameras, magnetic power banks, LED lights and portable blenders are popular picks. See gifts for teens for more.
